notify.bl_declined_hint.back: number from the black list: rejected while ringing (no AI)

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient address looks invalid

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: The AI failed to connect; the system hung up the call, and the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: The AI failed; the call went to voicemail

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: hidden number: a refusal message was played, then disconnected (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_reject_list.back: number from the black list: an unavailability message was played, then disconnected (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: the system considered the call a sales or fraudulent one ({t}); dragging out the call is turned off, so the AI answered as usual

notify.h_stall_released.back: the system first took the call for a sales or fraudulent one; a second check showed an ordinary call and the AI returned to speaking normally

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system considered the call a sales or fraudulent one, so the AI deliberately dragged out the call to waste the caller's time

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: the caller said the matter was urgent: the phone called the owner but did not get through, and the AI told the caller that the owner would call back soon; the call was not considered a sales or fraudulent one and was not dragged out, so in the "To do" field it says: call back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_failed.note: Quotes the to-do label Do zrobienia (s_todo); keep them in step

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said the matter was urgent: the phone called the owner, who answered and was connected with the caller, and the AI left the call; the call was not considered a sales or fraudulent one and was not dragged out

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said the matter was urgent, and the owner was notified immediately; the call was not considered a sales or fraudulent one and was not dragged out, so in the "To do" field it says: call back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_transfer.note: Quotes the to-do label Do zrobienia (s_todo); keep them in step

notify.n_blocked.back: A number from the black list called

notify.n_blocked_declined.back: Rejected while ringing: not answered, no AI

notify.n_blocked_done.back: Played "{}" and disconnected. AI was not used.

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you see it, the notification channel works.

notify.s_ai_fail_matter.back: The AI did not connect; the system hung up the call after about {}, and the caller heard nothing

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI did not connect; the system hung up the call]

notify.s_ai_failed.back: The AI did not connect and said nothing

notify.s_call_back_if_known.back: Call back if you know this number

notify.s_listen_recording.back: Listen to the recording in the control panel

notify.tc_confirm_ack.back: Confirmed, I'm taking care of it…

notify.vm_email_unknown.back: Asks for a reply by e-mail (confirmed with key 1, but the address is unknown)

notify.vm_no_choice.back: No way of replying was chosen (the call ended earlier)

notify.vm_no_transcript.back: The message lasts about {}; it could not be turned into text. Listen to the recording

notify.vm_task_failed.back: Voicemail (could not be turned into text; needs a quick look)

notify.ap_weekdays.back: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

notify.dt_fmt.note: fixed: numeric date %-d.%m instead of English month abbreviation. Month abbreviation %b is printed by the app in English (e.g. "21 Nov") inside Polish text; should be numeric such as %-d.%m, %H:%M.

call.speech.hello_again.note: Gender-neutral 'słychać mnie?' instead of a Pan or Pani form

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here, I can hear. I'm listening.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Is anyone on the line?
call.speech.still_there.note: Gender-neutral wording chosen to avoid Pan or Pani

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I have to think it over.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Ah, hang on, I have one more question.
call.speech.wait_one_more.note: fixed: restored the oh wait, I have one more question meaning and dropped dobrze?. Drops the 'oh wait / hold on' that stops the caller from hanging up and adds 'dobrze?'; should mean 'Oh wait, I have one more question' (e.g. 'Ach, zaraz, mam jeszcze jedno pytanie').

call.speech.no_wait.back: "just a moment", "a moment", "give me a moment", "I'll take a look in a sec"
call.speech.no_wait.note: fixed: now only the quoted local phrases, not a full instruction sentence. Whole instruction sentence ('Never say ...') instead of only the quoted phrases; the prompt inserts it after 'lines like', so it should be just "just a moment", "give me a moment", "let me see".

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number dialed is currently unavailable. Please try later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Ah, a parcel? Yes, please leave it at the door, thank you very much. / Okay, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: farewells: goodbye; for now (bye); until we speak; have a nice day. wrap-ups: I'm not keeping you any longer; I'll get in touch later; that's it for now. ends examples: "Thank you, goodbye." / "Okay, that's it for now. Have a nice day!" / "I'll call later, bye for now." not_ends examples: "Good day, this is Marek from the bank." / "I haven't made a decision yet, but I'm happy to keep listening." / "I won't keep you long, I just have a question about the account."
call.speech.closing.note: Chosen only from words already in Bageo's closing list; not verified

names.aliases.back: polski, polish, 'Polish language' (język polski), 'Polish language' without diacritics (jezyk polski), polska

app.about_dedicated.back: In AI mode the module takes over the phone app, mutes the ringer and turns on Do Not Disturb, so a spare phone works best. To use the phone normally for a while, turn off the switch at the top.

app.about_legal.back: Laws on recording calls and on informing callers that they are talking to an AI differ depending on location. Complying with them is up to you.

app.about_rollback.back: To remove Bageo completely, first turn off the switch at the top (back to a regular phone), then disable or delete the module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the phone.

app.agent_url_label.note: Source says 'Agent address'; written as 'Bageo address' because the glossary avoids 'agent'

app.btn_set.note: Button next to a setup step; 'Set' (as the default app)

app.check_priv_missing.back: Installed as a regular app (%1$s). Flash the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the phone. If the APK was installed manually, uninstall this copy.

app.check_priv_title.back: Installed as a privileged system app

app.check_privperm_desc.back: Granted by the module at startup. They cannot be granted on this screen.

app.check_uplink_idle.back: Not visible now. On some phones it appears only during a call; the app will notify you if passing the voice fails.

app.check_uplink_missing.back: Requires the module: the MODIFY_PHONE_STATE permission is missing.

app.check_uplink_title.back: Passing the AI's voice into the call

app.confirm_ai_body.back: This phone will start answering calls through AI: they will no longer ring, the AI will answer them. Google's Phone app will be disabled and Do Not Disturb turned on.

app.confirm_ai_title.back: Allow the AI to answer calls?

app.confirm_normal_body.back: The phone will ring and you will answer yourself. The AI will no longer answer calls on this phone.

app.connection_hint_usb.back: USB (default, recommended): leave ws://127.0.0.1:8765. The program on the computer forwards this port itself over the USB cable via adb reverse.

app.connection_hint_wifi.back: Wi-Fi: enter the address shown in the program on the computer, for example ws://192.0.2.10:8787/ws?token=… The phone and computer must be on the same network.

app.grant_perms.back: Allow the requested permissions, then tap "Start the service" again.

app.header_compat.back: Tested on Pixel 7, 7a, 8 and 9. Other rooted phones may work; try at your own risk.

app.ip_code_hint.back: You will find it on the "System" page in the control panel

app.ip_err_address.back: Enter the IP address of Bageo, for example 192.168.1.20.

app.ip_err_busy.back: Too many wrong codes. Wait a minute and try again.

app.ip_err_code.back: The pairing code is wrong or has expired. Get a new one in the control panel.

app.ip_err_unreachable.back: Cannot connect to this address. Make sure the phone and Bageo are on the same network.

app.ip_err_wifi_off.back: First turn on the "Phones can also connect over Wi-Fi" option in the control panel.
app.ip_err_wifi_off.note: Quotes a console setting label; check against the real Polish console label

app.mode_err_busy.back: The previous switching has not finished yet.

app.mode_err_dialer.back: Could not change the default phone app.

app.mode_err_dnd.back: Could not change the Do Not Disturb setting.

app.mode_err_in_call.back: A call is in progress; end it first.

app.mode_err_no_root.back: The Bageo module is not working. In Magisk or KernelSU check that the Bageo Uplink module is enabled, and restart the phone.

app.mode_err_screening.back: Could not change the call filtering setting.

app.mode_err_volume.back: Could not set the ringer volume.

app.mode_failed.back: Switching did not finish. %1$s You can try again.

app.mode_switch_hint.back: Turn off to use as a regular phone: calls ring and you answer yourself.

app.msg_no_browser.back: No app on this phone opens web pages.

app.msg_perm_settings.back: Some permissions can no longer be requested here. Allow them on the app's system settings page.

app.msg_url_invalid.back: The address must start with ws:// or wss:// and contain a host name.

app.msg_url_saved_pending.back: Saved. To use the new address, tap "Stop the service" and then "Start the service" when no call is in progress.

app.msg_url_saved_restarted.back: Saved. The service was restarted to use the new address.

app.msg_wifi_forgotten.back: The Wi-Fi connection was forgotten. To set it up again, connect the USB cable once.

app.notification_text_in_call.back: The AI is conducting the conversation.

app.route_custom.back: Connected to the address you entered.

app.st_normal.back: Regular phone: calls ring as usual

app.st_normal_d.back: The AI does not answer. You answer yourself, as on any phone. Turn on the switch below so the AI answers again.

app.st_offline_d.back: Check that Bageo is running on the computer and the phone is connected by USB cable or is on the same Wi-Fi network (first connect once by USB cable to pair).

app.st_service_off.back: The answering service is not running

app.step_battery_desc.back: Stops the Android system from closing Bageo to save battery, so you do not miss a call.

app.step_battery_title.back: Do not put Bageo to sleep in Android

app.step_dialer_desc.back: So that the phone does not show the call screen while the AI is speaking.

app.step_dialer_title.back: Set Bageo as the default phone app

app.step_dnd_desc.back: The phone is silent while the AI is answering.

app.step_dnd_title.back: Allow Bageo to control Do Not Disturb mode

app.step_module_missing.back: Flash the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the phone.

app.step_pair_ip.back: You cannot connect USB (e.g. Bageo runs in Docker): get a pairing code in the control panel and tap "Connect via IP address".

app.step_pair_missing.back: The first time: turn on USB debugging and connect the phone to the computer with Bageo. After pairing once, it also connects over Wi-Fi.

app.step_pair_ok.back: Paired with the computer. Calls work over Wi-Fi even after the cable is unplugged.

app.step_pair_title.back: Connect to the computer by USB cable to pair

app.step_screening_desc.back: So that incoming calls do not ring.

console.f_owner_h.back: The name that callers use. The AI uses it when it speaks about you.

console.f_owner_aliases.back: Other first names that callers use

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: A foreign-language name, a nickname etc. One per line, max. 10. The AI knows that it is about you.

console.style_assistant_d.back: Says that it is your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if it were you, but does not agree to anything on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key in Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model that the AI uses for talking. It rarely needs to be changed.

console.f_voice_h.back: The preview plays three sample sentences in the language selected above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are answered and immediately hung up. For the phone to ring normally, use the option "Switch to normal phone" on the System page or in the app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Rings for a moment before answering, as with a human. 0 = immediately.

console.f_normal_max.back: Max. duration of a normal conversation

console.f_normal_max_h.back: From 3 to 30. Just before the limit the AI politely ends the conversation and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI speaks up immediately after answering. Off: the caller waits 1-3 s.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: hidden numbers are handled by the AI like any other. Off: they hear a short announcement about unavailability and the conversation ends.

console.f_barge_h.back: The AI falls silent and listens when the caller cuts in. Not every phone supports this; Bageo checks it automatically.
console.f_barge_h.note: fixed: sprawdza to samo replaced by automatycznie

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini judge when the caller has finished speaking

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks in another language, the AI switches to it.

console.f_status_h.back: Brief information for now, e.g. where the courier should leave a parcel. The AI mentions it only when it fits the conversation.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Deliveries: please leave the parcel at reception.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds a quiet ambient sound behind the AI voice, so that it sounds like a real person.

console.amb_typhoon.note: Localised: 'Typhoon' became 'Wichura' (windstorm). Acceptable for a Polish audience.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when the caller is clearly selling something or trying to deceive.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI pretends to be interested and asks about details to waste the caller's time. It gives no data and agrees to nothing. Off: it refuses and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max.back: Max. duration of such a conversation

console.f_stall_max_h.back: From 3 to 30. Longer conversations use more of the Gemini limit.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = the same model as for normal conversations.

console.g_prompt_d.back: A few short answers will help the AI sound like you. All fields are optional.

console.f_prompt.note: fixed: same word as the other prompt labels

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the built-in instructions are used

console.f_prompt_h.back: When filled in, it replaces the conversation style and local customs. Each answering style has its own instructions; enter {owner} in place of your name.

console.p_builtin_h.back: For the saved language, answering style and name. If you have just changed them, save first.

console.p_replace_body.back: There is already text in the editor. It will be replaced with the built-in instructions.

console.f_knowledge_ph.back:
e.g. Parcels: please leave them at reception.
Opening hours: Mon-Fri, 9:00-18:00.

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Facts that callers may ask about - one per line. The AI must not make up anything that is not written here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: Played when rejecting a call from the blacklist or a hidden number. You manage the blacklist in the "Contacts" tab.

console.b_help.back: End the number with an asterisk * to block all numbers with the same beginning, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits, not counting leading zeros).

console.reject_announce.back: Answer, play the unavailability announcement and hang up

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The announcement is read in the language selected above.

console.rv_same.back: The same as the AI voice

console.g_notify_d.back: Receive a message when someone calls and a summary after the conversation ends.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: nothing is sent to any notification channel.

console.n_empty.back: No notification channels. Add a channel to receive conversation summaries on your phone.

console.n_ctl_h.back: Check conversations, order AI calls and handle "To do" tasks straight from this chat. Send /help to see the commands.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In a group, enter who can give commands - otherwise nobody will be able to. In a private chat you can leave it empty. You can check your ID with @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: First turn on the "Accept commands from this chat" option in a channel above.

console.rc_env.back: Accept commands in the Telegram chat set by environment variables

console.rc_env_h.back: The bot and chat from TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS restricts who can give commands.

console.rc_errands.back: Commissioned AI calls per chat per hour

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no commissioned AI calls from chats. Max. 30.

console.rc_msgs_h.back: After the limit is exceeded, the chat will not receive replies until the end of the minute.

console.mcp_title.back: Allow other AI tools to connect (MCP)

console.mcp_desc.back: Allows AI tools, such as Claude or ChatGPT, to check your conversations and "To do" tasks. Leave it off if you do not need it.

console.mcp_on_h.back: Works only when it is on and the Token below is set. The address is the control panel address with /mcp added.

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this Token in the AI tool (as a Bearer token).

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Yes, but ask me in chat first

console.mcp_calls_h.back: The "Ask first" option requires a chat that accepts commands.

console.mcp_errands_h.back: All AI tools in total, from 0 to 30.

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for AI tools running in a browser: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave empty.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot via @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: you can check yours with @userinfobot; for a group use the group ID and add the bot to it. Send the bot one message so that it can write to you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: enter the webhook URL (channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks > New webhook > Copy webhook URL) or the bot token and channel ID; one is enough. To receive private messages, enter your own ID in the channel ID field. Chat commands: enter the bot token and channel ID and enable the Message Content Intent option for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy the Incoming Webhook URL (also works with Mattermost) or enter the bot token and channel ID; one is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, then enter the bot token (xoxb-), the app token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console > your Messaging API channel: generate a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). First add the bot as a friend. The LINE Notify service was closed in 2025; this is its successor.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave the server field empty for ntfy.sh. A token is needed only for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps > Create application, then copy the token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on the iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application at pushover.net to get an API token. Your user key (User key) is in the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In a WeCom group: add a group bot and copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings > Bots > add your own bot and copy the webhook URL. If a signature ("Sign") was chosen as the security, paste the secret key (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings > Bots > Add bot > Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Do not enable signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan site.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), the access token of the sending account and the ID of the room this account belongs to (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google Account > Security > 2-step verification > App passwords). Not your usual password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification address of the Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which services receive the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL accepting JSON POST requests with the fields event, title, body and data. Useful for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's ... menu > Workflows > "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", finish the configuration and copy the URL you get. The old Office 365 connectors have been withdrawn.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space > Apps and integrations > Webhooks > Add webhook, then copy its URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration > Workspace > Integrations > New > Incoming: turn it on, choose the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings > Bots > Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter its email and API key as email:key. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone) or one or more email addresses for a private message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a room and enter the room ID or a person's email address.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: The address of your Nextcloud, user name and an app password (Settings > Security) written as user:password, and the conversation token (the last part of the conversation link).

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration > Incoming webhooks > Create, then copy the webhook URL. On a home network, the http:// address on port 5000 lets you avoid certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+...) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com > Settings > Account > Create Access Token. Leave the target empty to send to all devices or enter a device ID or email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. The group code sends to the group; an empty field sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Simplest: a simple push token (SPT_...) from the WxPusher site, without a target. Or the app's appToken (AT_...) and user IDs (UID_...) or topic IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app create a token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://...:465. The login is at the same time the sender. Use an app password if the mail provider offers one.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: The address of your Home Assistant, a long-lived access token (Profile > Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (visible under Developer tools > Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: You will find the key at ifttt.com/maker_webhooks > Documentation. Create an applet "If Webhooks: Receive a web request" with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 is the content.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications use this address. Empty = the grey address visible in the field; for Docker or access from outside the home, enter your own.

console.use_this_url.back: Use the address of this page: {url}

console.g_summary_d.back: After every conversation the AI writes a short summary. Usually nothing needs to be set here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any OpenAI-compatible service works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: By default it uses your Gemini key. To use another service, choose "Another service".

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date is agreed in a conversation (delivery, meeting), an "Add to calendar" link appears in the summary.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to arrange a date, the AI does not agree immediately - it says it will check and let them know. Then you press "Accept" or "Reject" in the "To do" section on the Conversations page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After your decision, the phone that answered the call sends an SMS to the caller (mobile numbers only). Off: the AI calls back instead.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: SMS to a mobile, AI call-back to a landline. Hidden numbers and numbers that cannot be called back (foreign, free, etc.) do not receive a reply.

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models with the word "thinking" in the name. "Low" answers fastest.

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, turn on USB debugging and open the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for consent: unlock the phone and accept the message "Allow USB debugging?".

console.ph_offline.back: Offline: unplug the cable and plug it in again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo app is not installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB connection works and the app is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB connection is not ready yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off.back: The USB helper is turned off

console.usb_off_d.back: Phones connect to Bageo over the network.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones cannot be configured automatically over USB. Install Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.

console.chk_key_bad.back: Add your key so that the AI can talk.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Tell the AI how callers address you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions in the "About you" section so that the AI sounds more like you.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: No phone is connected now. See the "Phones" section on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a channel to receive conversation summaries on your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: Requires a Gemini key or another summary service.

console.chk_ai_off.back: Answering by the AI is turned off

console.chk_all.back: Everything ready. Call your phone's number to test.

console.ev_hello_reattach.back: The phone reconnected during the conversation

console.ev_live_ai_start.back: The AI assistant was started (older menu)

console.ev_shaming_played.back: The announcement about wasting energy was played

console.ev_vm_end_hash.back: The message was ended with the # key

console.ev_vm_end_max.back: The message reached the time limit

console.ev_vm_end_silence.back: The message was ended after silence

console.ev_vm_end_hangup.back: The caller hung up while recording a message

console.ev_vm_no_reply.back: The caller does not ask for a reply

console.ev_vm_confirm_timeout.back: No answer regarding the way of contact

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No confirmation after reading out the contact details

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: The caller reported an error in the contact details

console.ev_vm_reply_contact_confirmed.back: The caller confirmed the contact details

console.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed.back: The caller asked for a call back

console.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voice.back: No sound from the AI, redirected to voicemail

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: The AI voice could not be played, redirected to voicemail

console.ev_call_waiting_rejected.back: A call during another conversation, rejected as busy

console.nf_smtp_target.back: Send to (empty = to the login address)

console.err_sms_not_retryable.back: This SMS cannot be sent again: the meeting has not yet been considered or the SMS has already gone out.

console.err_no_calendar.back: This conversation has no calendar proposal.

console.err_no_audio.back: This conversation has no recording of this type.

console.err_background_missing.back: The sound file for this background is missing.

console.err_preview_failed.back: Could not prepare the sample. Check the Gemini API key and try again.

console.err_bad_request.back: Bageo did not understand the request.

console.err_save_failed.back: Could not save the settings to disk.

console.err_fulfill_failed.back: Could not carry out the task.

console.err_unknown_channel.back: Bageo does not recognize this notification service.

console.err_bad_url.back: The field "{field}" must begin with http:// or https://.

console.err_auth_failed.back: The service rejected the token or password.

console.err_service_not_found.back: The service does not recognize this address or token.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported a problem with the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted, and Bageo does not support encrypted rooms. Use a room without encryption.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo will not send a notification to this address. Enter the proper address of the notification service.

console.err_network_error.back: Could not connect to the service.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices on the same network can open the control panel at http://name.local. Letters, digits and hyphens only. Empty = off.

console.cu_qr_h.back: Scan the code with the phone's camera to open the control panel on it.

console.cu_local.back: This address can be opened only on this computer.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code with the control panel address

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to the home screen. Next time it is enough to tap the icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share > Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ > Add to home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the install icon to the right of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: Phones that do not open .local addresses (some older Android phones) can use:

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Normal phone: calls ring, the AI does not answer

console.ph_need_update.back: Update the Bageo app on this phone to switch the mode from here

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: Calls to this phone will no longer be answered by the AI. The phone will ring like a normal phone and someone will have to answer. You can switch back at any time.

console.ph_now_normal.back: It now works like a normal phone

console.ph_now_ai.back: The AI answers on this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: During a conversation: switch after it ends

console.pm_err_in_call.back: the phone is in the middle of a conversation. Try after it ends

console.pm_err_busy.back: the phone is still finishing the previous switching

console.pm_err_no_root.back: the Bageo module is not working on the phone. In Magisk or KernelSU check whether the Bageo Uplink module is enabled and restart the phone

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: the phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: the phone could not change the default phone app

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: the phone could not change the call filtering setting

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: the phone could not change the Do Not Disturb mode

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: the phone could not turn the ringer back on

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: the phone did not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: the app on the phone is too old. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: The result has not been confirmed yet. Refresh the page in a moment.

console.pm_err_failed.back: something went wrong on the phone

console.er_new.back: Order a conversation from the AI

console.er_new_d.back: The AI will call, sort out the matter and give you the result. During the conversation you can read live captions and at any moment hint to the AI what to do.

console.er_to_ph.back: Type a name to find a contact or a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: No contact with that name. You can also type a number.

console.er_need_pick.back: Choose a contact from the list or type a phone number.

console.er_task_ph.back:
e.g. Reserve a table for 4 people for tomorrow at 19:00 under the name Kowalski, non-smoking; if 19:00 is taken, 19:30-20:00 is fine
or: Ask which day this weekend, Saturday or Sunday, suits him for dinner

console.er_task_h.back: Write what needs to be done and what conditions you accept. If the AI is unsure of something during the conversation, it will ask you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says it is calling on your behalf as an assistant.

console.er_id_owner_d.back: The AI speaks as if it were you.

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatically (a free line able to call this number)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (ordinary phone mode, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A phone in ordinary phone mode cannot make AI calls. Switch it back to "AI answers" on the System page.

console.er_pre_d.back: Fill them in so that the AI does not have to interrupt and ask during the conversation.

console.er_pre_sim.back: Use the number of this line

console.er_started.back: Passed to the AI. Dialing in progress.

console.er_queued.back: In the queue. The AI will call as soon as a phone becomes free.

console.er_empty_body.back: Describe above what needs to be done. The AI will call, take care of the matter and give you the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If nobody answers or the line is busy, it calls again every minute, at most 30 times.

console.er_redial_wait.back: Calling until success: attempt {n} without an answer, the next call at {time}

console.er_live_wait.back: Dialing the number, waiting for it to be answered...

console.er_watching.back: You are observing the conversation: in case of doubt the AI will ask you first.

console.er_q_over.back: Time is up, the AI will decide by itself

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI will end the conversation immediately. The matter may not be settled yet.

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not there, no answer

console.er_options.back: The other party's proposals. Choose one and the AI will call back with the answer:

console.er_fu_title.back: Reply and order another AI conversation

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI will call again: {who} and pass on this reply.

console.er_delete_t.back: Delete this order for the AI?

console.er_delete_b.back: It will disappear from this list. The records of conversations will remain.

console.er_err_no_number.back: Enter the number you want to call.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot call this number (emergency, special or premium-rate).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: No phone has a SIM card able to call numbers from this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has not yet answered any conversation, so the system does not know what SIM cards it has. Call it once and try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write what the AI is to get done.

console.er_err_task_too_long.back: The text is too long: at most 1000 characters.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: No phone with the AI is available now (no connected phone or all work as an ordinary phone).

console.er_err_not_found.back: This order for the AI or contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This conversation is still waiting in the queue or is in progress. Try after it ends.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The conversation has already ended, so the AI cannot pass this on.

console.f_er_identity.back: Orders for the AI: call as

console.f_er_identity_h.back: As whom the AI introduces itself when it calls for you. In each order you can change this.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: White list (family and close ones; can be put through to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: List for dragging out the conversation (the AI wastes their time from the start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How calls from this number are handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who can be put through to you and when. This does not replace emergency numbers.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Do not answer: redirect to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: The AI answers, puts you through in urgent matters

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number the phone calls in an urgent matter.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: After it is set, the control panel asks for it on opening (once per browser). Required to open the control panel on a phone or another computer.

console.pw_setup_title.back: Set a password for the control panel (optional)

console.pw_setup_body.back: Set a password if you will open this control panel from outside the home network. You can change it later in Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser will remember the password. On a new device you will have to enter it again.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password must have at least 8 characters.

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_transfer.back: Urgent: a notification was sent to you

console.g_region_d.back: Most people never need to change this.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: On a server channel enter who can give commands - otherwise nobody will be able to. In a private message you can leave it empty. Your ID: turn on Developer Mode, right-click your name > Copy user ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: On a channel enter who can give commands - otherwise nobody will be able to. In a private message you can leave it empty. Your member ID: open the profile > ⋮ > Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room with other people enter who can give commands - otherwise nobody will be able to. A room only with you and the bot can remain empty. A Matrix ID looks like this: @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Check conversations, order AI calls and handle "To do" tasks straight from this chat. Send "@your_bot /help" to see the commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Check conversations, order AI calls and handle "To do" tasks straight from this chat. Send "@your_bot /help" to see the commands.

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_merged.back: Urgent: you were connected with the caller

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: the AI disconnected while calling you

console.urg_why_merge.back: Could not connect you with the interlocutor

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone could not make the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write what you want to pass on.

console.er_err_text_too_long.back: The text is too long. Shorten it.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: This question has already been answered or the time has passed.

console.d_del_call_b.back: The summary, transcript and recording will be permanently deleted.

console.calls_clear_b.back: All finished conversations and their recordings will be permanently deleted. Conversations in progress will remain.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait for the conversation to end before deleting it.

console.ph_forget_b.back: Removes this disconnected phone from the list. The existing records of conversations will remain.

console.err_device_online.back: First disconnect this phone before you delete it.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait until the conversation on this phone ends.

console.ph_sim_num_ph.back: Enter the number of this SIM card

console.bl_mode.back: When a number from the black list calls:

console.bl_voice_link.back: Choose the voice of the announcement

console.ct_bad_prefix.back: Only numbers on the black list can end with an asterisk *, after at least 3 digits (not counting leading zeros).

console.sms_search_ph.back: Search for a sender or content

console.sms_empty_d.back: SMS messages received by your phones will appear here when SMS forwarding is on.

console.sms_pick.back: Choose a conversation or press "New SMS".

console.sms_no_line.back: No phone can send SMS messages now.

console.sms_no_reply.back: You cannot reply to this sender.

console.sms_err_old_app.back: The app on this phone is too old to send SMS messages.

console.sms_err_permission.back: The app on the phone has no permission for SMS. Allow it on the phone.

console.sms_err_generic.back: The phone could not send the message.
